煤的综合利用：以煤的气化为主线: Comprehensive Use of Coal: Coal Gasification
煤只能烧吗？怎么把煤变成能造化肥、造甲醇的气？: Can coal only be burned? How do we turn coal into a gas for making fertilizer and methanol?
C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂，吸热，把煤变成组成可调的气: C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂, endothermic, turns coal into a gas of adjustable composition
靠烧掉一部分煤供热：氧多则温度高，但更多碳变成 CO₂: Heat comes from burning part of the coal: more oxygen means higher temperature, but more carbon becomes CO₂
CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ 放热可逆；煤气化用耐硫变换，带硫也中毒不: CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ is exothermic and reversible; coal gasification uses sour shift, so sulfur cannot poison it
−40 ℃ 甲醇一次吸掉 H₂S 与 CO₂，硫送克劳斯变成硫磺: Methanol at −40 ℃ absorbs H₂S and CO₂ in one go; the sulfur goes to Claus and becomes elemental sulfur
甲醇要 H₂/CO ≈ 2，合成氨要 H₂/N₂ = 3（深变换 + 配氮）: Methanol needs H₂/CO ≈ 2, ammonia needs H₂/N₂ = 3 (deep shift + added nitrogen)
全对！氧供热、蒸汽产氢、变换调比例、脱硫保护催化剂，四件事都通了。: All correct! Oxygen for heat, steam for hydrogen, shift to adjust the ratio, desulfurization to protect the catalyst: all four make sense now.
建议回看主线：先气化，再供热与产氢的跷跷板，然后变换调比例，最后净化与去向。: Review the main thread: gasification first, then the seesaw of heat and hydrogen, then shift to adjust the ratio, and finally cleanup and destination.
氧煤比越大 → 炉温越高；但更多碳被完全氧化成 CO₂，有效气被稀释: Higher oxygen-to-coal ratio → hotter gasifier; but more carbon is fully oxidized to CO₂, diluting the useful gas
蒸汽是吸热剂又是氢源：多加产氢多、炉温低，碳转化率跟着降: Steam absorbs heat and supplies hydrogen: more steam gives more hydrogen and a cooler gasifier, and carbon conversion falls with it
剖开气化炉：燃烧区约 1600 ℃ → 气化区约 1400 ℃ → 激冷段 <3: Gasifier cut open: combustion zone about 1600 ℃ → gasification zone about 1400 ℃ → quench section <300 ℃ → slag bath
CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ 是放热可逆反应：温度越高，出口 CO 剩: CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ is exothermic and reversible: the higher the temperature, the more CO left at the outlet
低温甲醇洗一次吸掉 H₂S 与 CO₂，H₂S 送克劳斯变成硫磺: Rectisol absorbs H₂S and CO₂ in one go; H₂S goes to Claus to become sulfur
同一个气化岛：甲醇路线走部分变换 + 旁路配气，合成氨路线走深度变换 + 配氮: The same gasification island: the methanol route uses partial shift + bypass blending, the ammonia route uses deep shift + added nitrogen
煤挖出来直接烧不是挺好吗，为什么要先变成气？: Isn't it fine to just burn coal as mined? Why turn it into gas first?

Reference conditions running: useful gas 79.5 %, H₂/CO 2.33, carbon conversion 94.7 %, total sulfur 0.1 ppm
无新反应：这一步只讲「为什么要气化」: No new reaction: this step only covers "why gasify"
气化剂 = 水蒸气 + 氧气；产品气 = CO + H₂（合成气）: Gasifying agents = steam + oxygen; product gas = CO + H₂ (syngas)
煤主要含碳，另有氢、氧、氮、硫（烟煤约 C 84.4 %、S 1.8 %）。: Coal is mostly carbon, plus hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen and sulfur (bituminous coal about C 84.4 %, S 1.8 %).
直接燃烧：只拿到热，SO₂、粉尘、NOₓ 一起排出去。: Direct burning gives only heat, releasing SO₂, dust and NOₓ along with it.
气化：用蒸汽与氧气把碳变成 CO + H₂，成为组成可调的化工原料气。: Gasification uses steam and oxygen to turn carbon into CO + H₂, a chemical feed gas of adjustable composition.
去掉气化：煤只能当燃料烧，拿不到组成可控的原料气。: Without gasification, coal can only be burned as fuel, with no feed gas of controllable composition.
干馏 vs 气化 vs 液化：三者都是化学变化，产物分别是焦／油／气、气、液体燃: Carbonization vs. gasification vs. liquefaction: all three are chemical changes, giving coke/tar/gas, gas, and liquid fuel respectively.
煤是碳为主的复杂混合物，直接烧只拿到热，硫、尘、氮跟着排；气化把碳变成 CO +: Coal is a complex carbon-rich mixture; burning it gives only heat, with sulfur, dust and nitrogen emitted. Gasification turns the carbon into an adjustable CO + H₂ gas that can feed ammonia and methanol synthesis.
A3、A5、A8-E1、A8-E10、facts-补 B6: A3, A5, A8-E1, A8-E10, facts supplement B6
气化是吸热的，热量从哪来？为什么非要同时通氧和水蒸气？: Gasification is endothermic. Where does the heat come from? Why feed oxygen and steam together?
把氧煤比从 0.26 推到 0.30，盯住炉温、有效气与碳转化率: Push the oxygen-to-coal ratio from 0.26 to 0.30, watching gasifier temperature, useful gas and carbon conversion
缺氧自热：部分碳被 O₂ 氧化成 CO₂ 供热: Oxygen-starved self-heating: part of the carbon is oxidized by O₂ to CO₂ to supply heat
气化主式要吸 131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹，热量只能靠烧掉一部分煤。: The main gasification reaction absorbs 131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹, and the heat can only come from burning part of the coal.
供热靠部分燃烧：C + O₂ → CO₂ 放 393.5 kJ·mol⁻¹；2C: Heat comes from partial combustion: C + O₂ → CO₂ releases 393.5 kJ·mol⁻¹; 2C + O₂ → 2CO releases 221.1 kJ·mol⁻¹.
氧煤比 0.26 → 0.30：炉温 +106 ℃、碳转化率 +4.8 个百分点: Oxygen-to-coal ratio 0.26 → 0.30: temperature +106 ℃, carbon conversion +4.8 points, useful gas −1.0 point.
去掉供热：吸热反应自己降温，炉子会冷到 1200 ℃ 以下，碳转化率与熔渣流动性: Without heat supply the endothermic reaction cools itself; the gasifier drops below 1200 ℃ and carbon conversion and slag fluidity fall together.
「氧煤比能不能越大越好」要答两条：有效气被 CO₂ 稀释；炉衬会超温。: "Is a higher oxygen-to-coal ratio always better?" needs two points: useful gas is diluted by CO₂, and the lining overheats.
C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂ 要吸 131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹，这: C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂ absorbs 131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹, and that heat can only come from burning part of the coal. More oxygen means higher temperature and conversion, but useful gas is diluted by CO₂: the oxygen line supplies heat, the steam line supplies hydrogen.
A4.1–A4.3、A5.2、A8-E2、A8-E3、标准值 S2: A4.1–A4.3, A5.2, A8-E2, A8-E3, standard value S2
一千多度的炉子里，煤到底经历了什么？灰又去哪了？: In a gasifier at over a thousand degrees, what does the coal go through? Where does the ash go?
看剖开的气化炉转一圈：燃烧区、气化区、激冷段、渣池四个区: Turn the cut-open gasifier and see its four zones: combustion, gasification, quench and slag bath
剖开后看到烧嘴火焰约 1600 ℃、气化区约 1400 ℃、激冷段约 300 ℃: Cut open: burner flame about 1600 ℃, gasification zone about 1400 ℃, quench section about 300 ℃, slag bath about 80 ℃; molten slag leaves through the slag outlet
炉内分四个区（示意）：燃烧 → 气化 → 激冷 → 排渣: Four zones in the gasifier (illustrative): combustion → gasification → quench → slag removal
煤浆与氧气从顶置烧嘴并流喷入，先剧烈燃烧（约 1600 ℃），再被水蒸气气化（约: Coal slurry and oxygen are sprayed in co-currently from the top burner, first burning fiercely (about 1600 ℃), then gasified by steam (about 1400 ℃).
出气在激冷段被水直接冷却到 300 ℃ 以下，才能去洗涤与变换。: The outlet gas is cooled directly with water in the quench section to below 300 ℃ before going to scrubbing and shift.
气流床温度远高于灰熔点，灰以液态熔渣从渣口排出；几乎没有焦油，甲烷只有百分之一二: An entrained-flow bed runs far above the ash melting point, so ash leaves as liquid slag through the slag outlet; there is almost no tar and only one or two percent methane.
去掉激冷与洗涤：一千多度的气带尘直接进下游，管道和催化剂都受不了。: Without quench and scrubbing, gas at over a thousand degrees carrying dust would go straight downstream, too much for pipes and catalysts.
「为什么温度不能低于灰熔点」答的是排渣，不是反应速率。: "Why can't the temperature fall below the ash melting point?" The answer is slag removal, not reaction rate.
煤浆与氧气并流喷入：先烧（约 1600 ℃）、再气化（约 1400 ℃），出气在: Coal slurry and oxygen enter co-currently: burning first (about 1600 ℃), then gasification (about 1400 ℃); the outlet gas drops below 300 ℃ in the quench section and molten slag falls into the slag bath. The temperature must be above the ash melting point so ash can leave as liquid slag.
多通点水蒸气不是能多产氢吗？为什么不能一直加？: Doesn't more steam give more hydrogen? Why not keep adding it?
把蒸汽煤比从 0.55 提到 0.70，看炉温、H₂/CO 与碳转化率: Raise the steam-to-coal ratio from 0.55 to 0.70 and watch temperature, H₂/CO and carbon conversion
C(s) + H₂O(g) → CO(g) + H₂(g)（吸热，蒸汽既是吸热剂: C(s) + H₂O(g) → CO(g) + H₂(g) (endothermic; steam both absorbs heat and supplies hydrogen)
蒸汽煤比 0.40–0.70，与氧煤比配对: Steam-to-coal ratio 0.40–0.70, paired with the oxygen-to-coal ratio
蒸汽煤比 0.55 → 0.70：炉温 −85 ℃、H₂/CO 2.33 → 2: Steam-to-coal ratio 0.55 → 0.70: temperature −85 ℃, H₂/CO 2.33 → 2.61, carbon conversion −6.3 points.
H₂ rises from 33.5 % to 37.5 % and CO falls from 46.0 % to 42.0 % (dry basis).
水蒸气两个作用同向不同价：多产氢，但吃掉炉温。: Steam's two effects come together at different prices: more hydrogen, but it eats the temperature.
去掉水蒸气：只剩燃烧，产物几乎全是 CO₂，拿不到 H₂。: Without steam only combustion remains; the product is almost all CO₂ and there is no H₂.
「为什么不是蒸汽越多越好」答温度与转化率；「为什么不是越少越好」答缺氢、H₂/C: "Why not as much steam as possible?" Answer with temperature and conversion; "why not as little as possible?" Answer with hydrogen shortage and too low an H₂/CO.
蒸汽多 → 吸热多、炉温低 → H₂/CO 升高，但温度掉下来碳转化率跟着掉；蒸: More steam → more heat absorbed, lower temperature → H₂/CO rises, but carbon conversion falls with the temperature; less steam → higher temperature, H₂/CO too low. Steam and oxygen are a seesaw, and the reference 0.26 / 0.55 is their compromise.
A4.1、A5.2、A8-E4、B2.1 算式（1）（3）、标准值 S4: A4.1, A5.2, A8-E4, B2.1 formulas (1)(3), standard value S4
气化气里 H₂ 和 CO 的比例是固定的，下游要的比例不一样怎么办？: The H₂ to CO ratio in gasifier gas is fixed. What if downstream needs a different ratio?
把变换炉出口温度从 320 ℃ 推到 450 ℃，看出口 CO 与配气后的 H₂: Push the shift reactor outlet temperature from 320 ℃ to 450 ℃ and watch outlet CO and the blended H₂/CO
变换 ΔH = −41.2 kJ·mol⁻¹（由 NIST 生成焓相减，与维基转: Shift ΔH = −41.2 kJ·mol⁻¹ (from NIST enthalpies of formation, matching the figure quoted on Wikipedia).
去掉变换：H₂/CO 停在 0.73，甲醇要 2 —— 比例不对，合成塔吃不下。: Without shift, H₂/CO stays at 0.73 while methanol needs 2; with the wrong ratio the synthesis reactor cannot use it.
「为什么煤气化用耐硫变换」答：带着硫也能用，还顺手把 COS 转成 H₂S；铜锌: "Why does coal gasification use sour shift?" Answer: it works with sulfur present and also converts COS to H₂S; low-temperature Cu-Zn-Al catalysts are very sensitive to sulfur.
CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ 是放热可逆反应：温度低，平衡对 CO 的: CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ is exothermic and reversible: at low temperature equilibrium converts CO more completely; at high temperature more CO remains at the outlet. Coal gasification uses sour shift (Co-Mo), which works with H₂S present. Shift is the unit that adjusts the ratio, and more is not always better.
A4.4、A4.5、A6.6、A6.7、A8-E6、标准值 S6、S7: A4.4, A4.5, A6.6, A6.7, A8-E6, standard values S6, S7
气里那点硫黄味儿的东西，为什么非除掉不可？: Why must that little bit of rotten-egg-smelling stuff in the gas be removed?
把「低温甲醇洗脱硫」切掉，盯住总硫读数与去下游的管线: Switch off "Rectisol desulfurization" and watch the total sulfur reading and the line going downstream
总硫 0.1 ppm → 6000 ppm；去下游的管线变警示色；合成催化剂风险: Total sulfur 0.1 ppm → 6000 ppm; the downstream line turns to a warning color; synthesis catalyst risk alarm
H₂S/COS 来自煤中的硫: H₂S/COS come from sulfur in the coal
煤中硫 0.2–5 %（烟煤约 1.8 %），气化后主要是 H₂S，耐硫变换把: Coal contains 0.2–5 % sulfur (bituminous about 1.8 %); after gasification it is mainly H₂S, and sour shift converts COS to H₂S too.
低温甲醇洗：−40 ℃ 甲醇、2.76–6.89 MPa，可分别回收 H₂S 与: Rectisol: methanol at −40 ℃ and 2.76–6.89 MPa can recover H₂S and CO₂ separately.
克劳斯：2H₂S + O₂ → 2S + 2H₂O，热反应段 >850 ℃，受平: Claus: 2H₂S + O₂ → 2S + 2H₂O, thermal stage >850 ℃, limited by equilibrium so several stages are needed.
去掉脱硫：总硫 6000 ppm 进合成塔，甲醇合成（铜基）与合成氨（铁基）催化: Without desulfurization, 6000 ppm total sulfur enters the synthesis reactor, poisoning the methanol (copper-based) and ammonia (iron-based) catalysts and shutting down everything downstream.
「为什么合成之前必须深度脱硫」答催化剂中毒 + SO₂ 排放；不要说成「保护变换: "Why must gas be deeply desulfurized before synthesis?" Answer: catalyst poisoning + SO₂ emissions; don't say "to protect the shift catalyst".
煤里的硫在炉内变成 H₂S，耐硫变换又把 COS 转成 H₂S。它进甲醇合成塔（: Sulfur in coal becomes H₂S in the gasifier, and sour shift turns COS into H₂S as well. Entering a methanol (copper-based) or ammonia (iron-based) reactor it poisons and deactivates the catalyst, and released it becomes SO₂. So methanol at −40 ℃ absorbs H₂S and CO₂ in one go, and the sulfur goes to Claus to become elemental sulfur.
A3、A6.3、A6.4、A6.5、A8-E5、A8-E8、标准值 S8: A3, A6.3, A6.4, A6.5, A8-E5, A8-E8, standard value S8
同样是这套气，怎么一会儿做甲醇、一会儿做合成氨？: With the same gas, how can we make methanol one moment and ammonia the next?
把产品气去向切到合成氨，对比变换深度与下游装置: Switch the product gas destination to ammonia and compare shift depth and the downstream unit
小读数由「配气后 H₂/CO 2.33」变为文字「配氮后 H₂/N₂ = 3.0: The small readout changes from "blended H₂/CO 2.33" to the text "H₂/N₂ after adding nitrogen = 3.00"; downstream becomes the ammonia synthesis reactor; shift outlet CO 1.16 % (deep shift)
甲醇 H₂/CO ≈ 2；合成氨 H₂/N₂ = 3 + 配氮: Methanol H₂/CO ≈ 2; ammonia H₂/N₂ = 3 + added nitrogen
同一个气化岛两种原料气: One gasification island, two feed gases
甲醇合成每 mol CO 耗 2 mol H₂（CO + 2H₂ → CH₃OH: Methanol synthesis uses 2 mol H₂ per mol CO (CO + 2H₂ → CH₃OH), and CO₂ also takes part.
合成氨 3H₂ + N₂ ⇌ 2NH₃，配比 3 : 1，氮来自空分。: Ammonia synthesis 3H₂ + N₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ needs a 3 : 1 ratio, with nitrogen from air separation.
本课设定：甲醇路线 φ = 0.55（旁路配气）；合成氨路线 φ = 1.00（: Lesson setting: methanol route φ = 0.55 (bypass blending); ammonia route φ = 1.00 (full shift), outlet CO 1.16 % at 200 ℃.
去掉这一步（不调组成）：比例不对的合成气只能当燃料烧，做不了甲醇也做不了氨。: Skip this step (no composition adjustment) and syngas with the wrong ratio can only be burned as fuel, making neither methanol nor ammonia.
「为什么合成氨要配氮、甲醇不配」：合成氨的氮是反应物，甲醇的碳来自 CO。: "Why does ammonia need added nitrogen but methanol does not?" Nitrogen is a reactant in ammonia synthesis, while methanol's carbon comes from CO.
甲醇要 H₂/CO ≈ 2，合成氨要 H₂/N₂ = 3。甲醇走部分变换 + 旁: Methanol needs H₂/CO ≈ 2, ammonia needs H₂/N₂ = 3. Methanol uses partial shift + bypass blending (55 % through the shift reactor); ammonia uses deep shift + added nitrogen (from air separation). Same gasification island; what changes is the shift depth and the blending or nitrogen.
A7.1–A7.3、A8-E7、B2.1 算式（5）、标准值 S9: A7.1–A7.3, A8-E7, B2.1 formula (5), standard value S9
考核：你来当班长——能不能把气调成甲醇要的比例，又不把炉子烧坏？: Check: you are the shift leader. Can you bring the gas to the ratio methanol needs without wrecking the gasifier?
把 H₂/CO 调到 2.00 ± 0.08，同时有效气 ≥ 79.0 %、碳转: Bring H₂/CO to 2.00 ± 0.08 with useful gas ≥ 79.0 %, carbon conversion ≥ 92 %, total sulfur ≤ 1 ppm and gasifier temperature 1300–1500 ℃, and hold for 15 s
达标横幅；参考解 氧煤比 0.26 / 蒸汽煤比 0.55 / 变换 400 ℃: Pass banner; reference solution oxygen-to-coal 0.26 / steam-to-coal 0.55 / shift 400 ℃ → H₂/CO 2.01, useful gas 79.5 %, carbon conversion 94.7 % (S10)
全流程汇总：气化 → 耐硫变换 → 净化 → 去向: Whole process: gasification → sour shift → cleanup → destination
三个滑杆都要在操作带内：氧煤比 0.23–0.30、蒸汽煤比 0.40–0.70: All three sliders must stay in their operating bands: oxygen-to-coal 0.23–0.30, steam-to-coal 0.40–0.70, shift 200–450 ℃.
炉温 ≥ 1550 ℃（氧煤比推太高）走「3 秒倒计时 → 超温 → 复盘」；≤: Gasifier ≥ 1550 ℃ (oxygen too high) leads to "3 s countdown → overtemperature → review"; ≤ 1200 ℃ (too much steam) leads to the low-temperature chain.
H₂/CO 靠变换温度调：400 ℃ 时 2.01，320 ℃ 时 2.33。: H₂/CO is adjusted with shift temperature: 2.01 at 400 ℃, 2.33 at 320 ℃.
没有新结论：前七步的条件同时照顾到就是全部。: No new conclusion: handling the conditions of the first seven steps at once is all it takes.
工业题常问「为什么气化炉要同时进氧和水蒸气」：一个供热、一个产氢，谁也替不了谁。: Industrial questions often ask "why does the gasifier take both oxygen and steam?" One supplies heat, the other hydrogen; neither can replace the other.
考核没有新结论：氧煤比定温度与纯度，蒸汽煤比定氢与温度，变换温度定比例，脱硫定合: The check has no new conclusion: the oxygen-to-coal ratio sets temperature and purity, the steam-to-coal ratio sets hydrogen and temperature, shift temperature sets the ratio, and desulfurization decides whether the synthesis catalyst survives. Four knobs, each with its own job, together make a qualified feed gas.
磨成煤粉、加水制成煤浆，才泵得进高压炉子: Ground to powder and mixed with water into slurry so it can be pumped into the high-pressure gasifier
煤浆与氧气并流燃烧，碳变成 CO + H₂，灰熔成渣排出: Coal slurry and oxygen burn co-currently, carbon becomes CO + H₂, and ash melts into slag
带硫也不中毒：Co-Mo 催化剂把 CO 换成 H₂，还把 COS 变成 H₂S: Not poisoned by sulfur: the Co-Mo catalyst shifts CO into H₂ and turns COS into H₂S
甲醇要 H₂/CO ≈ 2，合成氨要 H₂/N₂ = 3（配氮）: Methanol needs H₂/CO ≈ 2, ammonia needs H₂/N₂ = 3 (added nitrogen)

出变换气降温后送净化: Shifted gas is cooled and sent to cleanup
先洗掉尘与部分 H₂S: Washes out dust and some H₂S first
炉温与有效气—氧煤比: Gasifier temperature and useful gas vs. oxygen-to-coal ratio
Class goal: H₂/CO 2.00 ± 0.08 held for 15 s, useful gas ≥ 79.0 %, total sulfur ≤ 1 ppm
气化炉超温 → 炉衬与水冷壁烧损: Gasifier overtemperature → lining and water walls burn
A. 为提高碳转化率、把氧煤比一路推高: A. To raise carbon conversion, the oxygen-to-coal ratio is pushed up and up
炉温冲过 1500 ℃ 后继续上升，碳转化率已封顶，有效气反而被 CO₂ 稀释。: The temperature passes 1500 ℃ and keeps rising; carbon conversion has already topped out, and useful gas is diluted by CO₂.
B. 水冷壁挂渣被冲刷、耐火层超温: B. Slag coating on the water walls is scoured away and the refractory overheats
局部温度超过材料极限，水冷管与炉衬开始损伤。: Local temperatures exceed material limits, and the water tubes and lining start to fail.
C. 熔渣变稀、渣口负荷过大: C. Slag becomes thin and the slag outlet is overloaded
排渣失控，激冷水与高温熔渣剧烈接触，蒸汽暴沸。: Slag discharge runs out of control; quench water meets hot slag violently and steam bursts out.
D. 联锁停车、炉子检修数天: D. Interlock shutdown, gasifier under repair for days
当班产量归零，下游甲醇 / 氨全线停车。: The shift's output drops to zero, and downstream methanol / ammonia shut down entirely.
炉温联锁（课件设定 1550 ℃）自动减氧: Gasifier temperature interlock (lesson setting 1550 ℃) cuts oxygen automatically
水冷壁多点壁温监测 + 挂渣保护: Multi-point water wall temperature monitoring + slag coating protection
氧煤比与蒸汽煤比联合控制，按煤种设定上限: Control oxygen-to-coal and steam-to-coal ratios together, with upper limits set by coal type
渣口与激冷室定期检查，防止堵渣: Inspect the slag outlet and quench chamber regularly to prevent blockage
记住这条链：氧多 → 超温 → 炉衬烧损 → 停车。碳转化率早就封顶了，多给的氧: Remember the chain: too much oxygen → overtemperature → lining burns → shutdown. Carbon conversion had long topped out; the extra oxygen only burned useful gas into CO₂.
气化炉低温 → 气化不完全、渣口堵塞: Gasifier too cold → incomplete gasification, blocked slag outlet
A. 为多产氢，把蒸汽煤比加到过头: A. To make more hydrogen, the steam-to-coal ratio is pushed too far
吸热量超过供热，炉温跌到 1200 ℃ 以下。: Heat absorbed exceeds heat supplied, and the gasifier falls below 1200 ℃.
B. 碳转化率下降、灰渣发黏: B. Carbon conversion falls and the slag turns sticky
未转化的碳随渣带走，熔渣流动性变差。: Unconverted carbon leaves with the slag, and slag fluidity worsens.
C. 渣口结渣、排渣不畅: C. Slag builds up at the outlet and discharge is poor
渣池堆积，激冷室液位与压差异常。: Slag piles up in the bath; quench chamber level and pressure difference become abnormal.
D. 被迫降负荷停车清渣: D. Forced to cut load and shut down to clear slag
气化炉与下游一起停。: The gasifier and everything downstream stop.
蒸汽煤比按煤种与负荷设定上限: Set an upper steam-to-coal limit by coal type and load
渣口压差与渣样在线监控: Monitor slag outlet pressure difference and slag samples online
发现渣黏先提氧温、再减蒸汽: If slag turns sticky, raise oxygen and temperature first, then cut steam
蒸汽不是越多越好：它既是氢源也是吸热剂。炉温掉到灰熔点附近，渣就排不出去。: More steam is not always better: it is both a hydrogen source and a heat sink. Once the temperature falls near the ash melting point, slag cannot get out.
本课目标：把 H₂/CO 调到 2.00 并保持 15 秒；把氧煤比推过 0.3: Lesson goal: bring H₂/CO to 2.00 and hold for 15 s; pushing oxygen-to-coal past 0.30 or steam-to-coal above 0.70 causes an accident, which you must understand, review and repair.
物理变化，只是把煤磨细了: A physical change: the coal is just ground finer
化学变化，煤中的碳变成 CO 和 H₂: A chemical change: the carbon in coal becomes CO and H₂
物理变化，只是把煤加热: A physical change: the coal is just heated
化学变化，但产物只有 CO₂: A chemical change, but the only product is CO₂
气化是用气化剂（水蒸气、氧气）把煤里的有机物转化成合成气的化学加工过程，主式 C: Gasification is chemical processing that uses gasifying agents (steam, oxygen) to turn the organic matter in coal into syngas, main reaction C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂; carbonization, gasification and liquefaction are all chemical changes.
气化炉为什么必须同时通氧气和水蒸气？: Why must a gasifier be fed with both oxygen and steam?
氧气产氢、水蒸气供热: Oxygen makes hydrogen and steam supplies heat
水蒸气与碳的反应吸热，要靠一部分碳燃烧供热；水蒸气同时是氢源: The steam–carbon reaction is endothermic and needs heat from burning part of the carbon; steam is also the hydrogen source
只是为了把煤粉吹进炉子: Only to blow the coal powder into the gasifier
C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂ 吸热（+131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹）: C + H₂O(g) → CO + H₂ is endothermic (+131.3 kJ·mol⁻¹); the heat comes from burning part of the carbon (C + O₂ → CO₂, exothermic), and steam is the source of the H₂ in the product.
炉温升高、碳转化率提高，但有效气含量下降: Higher temperature and carbon conversion, but lower useful gas content
炉温降低、有效气含量提高: Lower temperature and higher useful gas content
炉温升高、有效气含量也提高: Higher temperature and higher useful gas content
多给的氧把更多碳完全氧化成 CO₂：温度升高、碳转化率上升，但 CO + H₂（: The extra oxygen fully oxidizes more carbon to CO₂: temperature and carbon conversion rise, but CO + H₂ (useful gas) is diluted by CO₂ and its content falls.
气流床气化炉的温度为什么必须高于灰熔点？: Why must an entrained-flow gasifier run above the ash melting point?
为了让灰以液态熔渣排出，不堵渣口: So the ash leaves as liquid slag without blocking the slag outlet
为了让煤浆容易泵送: To make the coal slurry easier to pump
为了提高合成气热值: To raise the heating value of the syngas
灰熔点以上灰才熔成液态渣、从渣口流走；温度低于灰熔点，灰发黏结渣，排渣不畅，只能: Only above the ash melting point does ash melt into liquid slag and flow out; below it the ash turns sticky and builds up, slag discharge fails, and the unit must shut down.
把蒸汽煤比一直加大，最主要的代价是: The main cost of keeping on increasing the steam-to-coal ratio is
炉温下降，碳转化率降低: Lower temperature and lower carbon conversion
水蒸气与碳的反应吸热：加得越多吸热越多，炉温越低；炉温掉下来碳转化率跟着降（H₂: The steam–carbon reaction is endothermic: the more steam, the more heat absorbed and the cooler the gasifier; as it cools carbon conversion falls (while H₂/CO actually rises).
变换炉温度升高，出口 CO 含量: If the shift reactor temperature rises, outlet CO content
下降，因为反应更快: Falls, because the reaction is faster
升高，因为变换是放热可逆反应，升温使平衡左移: Rises, because shift is exothermic and reversible, and heating shifts equilibrium to the left
CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ 是放热反应（−41.2 kJ·mol⁻¹: CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂ is exothermic (−41.2 kJ·mol⁻¹), so the equilibrium constant falls as temperature rises: Kp ≈ 210 at 200 ℃ but only about 7.4 at 450 ℃, and outlet CO rises from 1.16 % to 13.54 %.
合成之前为什么必须深度脱硫？: Why must gas be deeply desulfurized before synthesis?
为了不让 H₂S 使甲醇合成（铜基）、合成氨（铁基）催化剂中毒，并避免 SO₂: To stop H₂S poisoning the methanol (copper-based) and ammonia (iron-based) catalysts, and to avoid SO₂ emissions
为了提高合成气的热值: To raise the heating value of the syngas
为了让 CO₂ 更容易脱除: To make CO₂ easier to remove
煤气化用耐硫变换（Co-Mo），带硫也能工作；真正怕硫的是下游合成催化剂。低温甲: Coal gasification uses sour shift (Co-Mo), which works with sulfur present; what really fears sulfur is the downstream synthesis catalyst. Rectisol absorbs H₂S and CO₂ together, and the sulfur is recovered by Claus.
做甲醇与做合成氨，对原料气的要求分别是: The feed gas requirements for methanol and for ammonia are
甲醇要 H₂/CO ≈ 2，合成氨要 H₂/N₂ = 3: Methanol needs H₂/CO ≈ 2, ammonia needs H₂/N₂ = 3
甲醇要 H₂/N₂ = 3，合成氨要 H₂/CO ≈ 2: Methanol needs H₂/N₂ = 3, ammonia needs H₂/CO ≈ 2
合成甲醇每 mol CO 耗 2 mol H₂；合成氨 3H₂ + N₂ ⇌ 2: Methanol synthesis uses 2 mol H₂ per mol CO; ammonia synthesis 3H₂ + N₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ needs H₂ and N₂ at 3 : 1, with nitrogen from air separation. So methanol uses partial shift with blending, ammonia uses deep shift with added nitrogen.
达产成功：H₂/CO 稳定在 2.00，有效气与硫残留都合格: On target: H₂/CO steady at 2.00, useful gas and residual sulfur both within spec
已回到参考工况：氧煤比 0.26 / 蒸汽煤比 0.55 / 变换 320 ℃，: Back to reference conditions: oxygen-to-coal 0.26 / steam-to-coal 0.55 / shift 320 ℃, desulfurization on
脱硫已切断：总硫从 0.1 ppm 升到 6000 ppm，下游合成催化剂在中毒: Desulfurization cut off: total sulfur rises from 0.1 ppm to 6000 ppm and the downstream synthesis catalyst is being poisoned
脱硫已投用：H₂S 与 CO₂ 被 −40 ℃ 甲醇吸掉，硫送克劳斯回收: Desulfurization on: H₂S and CO₂ are absorbed by methanol at −40 ℃, and the sulfur goes to Claus recovery
异常：变换炉温度被拉到 260 ℃，H₂/CO 已经偏离目标——请调回 400: Fault: the shift reactor temperature was pulled to 260 ℃ and H₂/CO has drifted off target; bring it back to around 400 ℃
抢修完成：更换炉衬 / 复位参数，重新开车: Repair done: lining replaced / parameters reset, restarted
紧急停车：切断煤浆与氧气、通氮置换，联锁解除: Emergency shutdown: coal slurry and oxygen cut off, purged with nitrogen, interlock released
